value.rationale: An exact mixed extrema covariance for every fixed tree gives a structural, degree-decorated edge-and-wedge kernel with the striking positive/negative sign switch between distance one and distance two. The result addresses joint uncertainty of random energy landscape minima and maxima; it is not an isolated finite enumeration or a parameter renaming.
